acoustic_rayleigh_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: High-velocity non-contact boundary extrusion of dense 95A TPU (Plate 1). Sliced with an automated 2.0 Bar continuous compressed-air cooling purge routed directly into the internal coaxial scrubber jacket to lock crystal temperatures below 65C. The 40 kHz surface array glides Rayleigh waves along the external skin of the molten plastic to shape its boundary supportless, while the bed executes a 120 Hz horizontal vibration loop to settle internal density uniformly without molecular scorching.

acoustic_rayleigh_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: High-velocity boundary extrusion of semi-crystalline Polypropylene (Plate 2). Drives a 2.2 Bar air shield to stabilize the outer PP skin layer while running the 120 Hz torsional bed sweep to fully skip brittle crystallization rows across the living hinges, backed by high-velocity auxiliary fan end-quenching.
